scope: Read-only source audit and memory/component-spec reproduction; no browser/image decoder execution

newFailure.basis: actual createManualComponents.ManualFigure output has svg/image and no img. ManualPrint waits and naturalWidth-checks img only; presence-based contentIssues does not reject existing invalid bytes. Cropped image therefore has no decode/error check in current source. A4 geometry may be measurable regardless of underlying byte validity.
newFailure.prioritySuggestion: P2: damaged cropped image may proceed through print preflight; keep independent of P1 body loss

otherGaps.coverLogoIssueId: naturalWidth issue uses closest data-print-id; logo only has ancestor data-page-id, so correction ID undefined
otherGaps.cropSourceDimensions: v2 validates numeric bounds relative to declared dimensions, not actual raster dimensions
otherGaps.mime: file picker checks MIME and <=20MiB, then Image.decode; codec checks declared data URL MIME/base64 length, not signature

recovery.picker: FileReader then Image.decode before asset map change; decode reject retains existing document/assets; catch displays error, retry via same picker
recovery.replace: request generation/document guard and target existence; UUID asset key; update same figure ID/alt/caption/opaque metadata, remove crop; old asset map entry retained; failed command restores prior map
recovery.import: decode→copy IDs→protected install→autosave; no upfront Image.decode; imported damaged bytes retained
recovery.authoring: figure uses raw img or svg/image; no dedicated broken-image onError placeholder; missing key shows add-image span
recovery.a4: waits only incomplete img; completed failed img and svg/image proceed to DOM geometry; load/error capture requests remeasure without validity diagnostic
recovery.print: uncropped img loads/errors settle; naturalWidth0 blocks print and figure ID routes correction; cropped svg/image is outside those queries

constraints: no full suite or repeated green
